CAREERS

Join our Trailblazing Team

Passionate about tech and driven by real-world missions?

SPEAR is a system house recognized for its advanced, revolutionary, encapsulated weapons portfolio. A group of soldiers at heart, we are committed to safeguarding military personnel through innovation, impact, and community. And we are looking for like-minded people to join us.

Every project is a mission, and every mission is personal.

If you’re ready to be a part of something bigger – we want to hear from you!
